title: Shelf Bridge
user: Board-game collectors moving a BoardGameGeek collection into a personal tracker who need their ownership, wishlist, and past-ownership states to survive an import predictably.
smallest_useful_product: Static web converter that imports a BGG collection export, lets users map statuses/ratings/comments to a target-neutral schema, validates duplicates, and exports CSV/JSON profiles for Yamtrack and NeoDB-style imports.
success_measure: At least 80% of ten real BGG exports complete a conversion with zero unreviewed status drops; half of pilot users export to two destinations from the same normalized file.
constraints: Use only user-supplied exports; respect BGG and target-service terms; do not redistribute game metadata, images, or reviews; process files locally.
